# Markdown to Word

> Free, open-source tool that converts GitHub Flavored Markdown into formatted Word (.docx) documents — entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

## The converter

[Markdown to Word](https://md2word.app/) takes Markdown three ways: drop a `.md` file onto the page, choose one with the file picker, or paste Markdown into the text box. It produces a Word document you can download as a `.docx`, and a preview you can copy as formatted text to paste straight into Word or Google Docs.

It supports GitHub Flavored Markdown: headings (as Word's Heading 1–6 styles), bold, italic, strikethrough, bulleted and numbered lists, task lists (as ☒ and ☐ items), tables (bordered, with a header row that repeats on each page), links, inline code and fenced code blocks (in a monospace font, line breaks kept), block quotes, and horizontal rules. The first heading becomes the document's title and file name.

AI chat apps such as ChatGPT and Claude answer in Markdown, so pasting a response here turns it into a properly formatted Word document instead of text full of asterisks and pound signs.

An optional style, Chinese official document (公文), sets the fonts and sizes customary for Chinese government documents: FangSong body text, FZXiaoBiaoSong, SimHei, and KaiTi headings, and Times New Roman for Latin text.

## How it works

The page converts Markdown to HTML with [marked](https://marked.js.org/), then builds the `.docx` with [html-to-docx](https://github.com/TurboDocx/html-to-docx), all in JavaScript running in the browser. No server is involved.

## Privacy

Markdown and the documents made from it never leave the device. The hosted site at md2word.app uses Cloudflare Web Analytics for anonymous, cookie-free usage statistics. See [Privacy](https://md2word.app/privacy/).

- The reverse converter, Word to Markdown: https://word2md.com/
